source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (echarts.js) under node, svg painter answering getType canvas, ssr init then _ssr = false, env.node = false
notes: The clock is reset to T0 per case; setOption steps every clip once at T0 (sample 0); a later sample is T0 + t, one zr.animation.update(), getDisplayList(true).
hover is handler.findHover after the event; dataIndex NaN is the string NaN.
trail is the zr.configLayer the canvas branch of LinesView asks for its zlevel; the motion blur itself is not recorded.

cases.note: three straight lines, the defaults: opacity 0.5, no symbols, the palette colour
series curveness 0.3; items -0.25, an explicit 0 (straight), the string "0.5", and a horizontal one
polyline: true -- three, five and two points; symbols and labels are not drawn on a polyline
symbols: the series pair, an item string, an item pair with a 0 size (the series size stays), emptyCircle, on a curve
labels: end with no distance, start, middle 6, insideStartTop [4, 8], insideEndBottom, insideMiddle, a reversed line, curves, the default texts
a label formatter template over the item: {a} {b} {c}
the palette over three series; series lineStyle width 2 dotted opacity 1; items with their own colour, width, opacity, dashed
the data formats: bare coords arrays, the flat typed format [count, x, y, ...] (dimensions given: the dev build asserts them), the ec2 pairs
category axes: coords by name, an unknown name (not drawn), by index
a null coordinate: the item is not drawn; a NaN in the second point too
lines past the axis range: the clip rect (default true) and clip: false
on a polar: radius then angle
on a calendar: the date of each coordinate; a date out of the range is not drawn (dataToPoint clamps by default)
no coordinateSystem: the default is geo, there is none, nothing is drawn
effect show: the defaults (period 4, delay idx/count*period/3, a circle of 3); straight and curved
constantSpeed 80 px/s, an arrow [8, 6] in its own colour, a delay of 300
loop false, period 1: the symbol is removed when its clip is done
trailLength 0.4 with a rect [3, 8]: the zlevel, the motion blur, the trail scaleY
symbol 'line' and 'roundRect' trails beside a bar series; the components and the later series get the next zlevel
trailLength 0: no motion blur, no zlevel of its own
a polyline effect (EffectPolyline): the offsets, the frame search forward and back across the loop
a polyline effect at constantSpeed 120
roundTrip: __t runs to 2 over twice the period and the symbol comes back
an item's own effect: period 1.5 and a diamond; an item's effect.show false is ignored (the series decides)
the enter animation: shape.percent 0 -> 1 (1000 ms cubicOut); the symbols scale and ride the end; the labels follow
a polyline does not animate in
the enter and the effect together; animationDuration 600
large, largeThreshold 3, six straight lines: hovering row 0 finds no data, a later row a NaN dataIndex
large curved lines: the quadratic containStroke
large polylines: the count in the segs, the bbox reading counts as coordinates, the second segment tested from the first point
large polylines whose segs hold an odd count of numbers: the bounding rect reads past the end and is not a number, nothing is hovered
large true, five lines under the threshold 6: drawn normally
large true, ten lines under the default threshold 2000
a large batch in its own colour, width 3, opacity 0.8; clip off
two series with names, a legend and the item tooltip: a line, a curve, a symbol, off and leave
emphasis focus 'series' with its own lineStyle; blur lineStyle; highlight and downplay actions
legend icons; a legend hover highlights the series; a toggle hides it
an unnamed series: an item's name, from > to, only a fromName, nothing (the series' own name is the fallback upstream reads first)
hovering a polyline and its tooltip
